stage2_findings: 405.575949 tok/s is a verified median decode-only rate for one 2048-input plus 2048-output request; full-wall output rate is about 368.97 tok/s.
826.171840 tok/s is verified c8 aggregate output divided by full batch wall for 1024 input plus 512 output per request; same-cell NVIDIA NVFP4 is 1097.429121 tok/s.
The complete stack is packed EXL3 plus DFlash2 block 8, SGLang scheduling, decode graphs, target NVFP4 KV, draft FP8 KV and ReplaySSM; the benchmark is not a codec-only result.
Published launcher disables optional custom EXL3 paths, but measured c84 receipts do not bind its environment/image/source, so the measured kernel-path attribution is unproven.
The target supplies 573 valid mul1 packed quartets, while tensor_storage lists only 401 and omits vision/MTP; loader discovery must be safetensors-first.
The draft has 36 packed modules; fc is the DFlash input projection, not the selector. The acceptance-neutral wording lacks an equivalence test.
Synthetic c8 acceptance is near the block-8 ceiling, requiring realistic-content and fail-fast acceptance panels for any local throughput claim.
